$comment: FND-05 deliverable 6 — the fixed signing fixture for the PRD §34.8 replay.
NOT A CREDENTIAL. The `secret` and `rotatedSecret` values below are constants chosen for this
fixture so the expected signature is reproducible offline. They authorise nothing, they are not
issued by anything, and no deployment may ever use them. `packages/contracts/src/events/sign.ts`
reads no environment variable and no file: the secret is always an argument (PRD §20.2).
Every key and every value here is lower-case on purpose. FND-02's CI secret scan applies the
seven name-shaped tools/fixtures/secret-patterns.json patterns to every git-tracked file outside
docs/**, so an UPPER_SNAKE identifier ending in _SECRET / _KEY / _TOKEN / _PASSWORD /
_CREDENTIAL(S), or starting with AWS_, would fail the scan job (sub-PRD D20b).
`timestampSeconds` is PRD §34.8's own X-AER-Timestamp value (docs/PRD.md line 2091).
`expectedSignature` was computed once, from the bytes of alert-created.signed.json, and is
COMMITTED: the suite compares against this literal, never against a sign/verify round trip, which
would pass even with the wrong signing input (ticket Test plan step 2).
`placeholders` is the substitution map that derives every *.signed.json / *.concrete.txt file
from its byte-verbatim PRD sibling. fixtures.test.ts proves the derivation byte-for-byte, so
nothing can be smuggled into a concrete instance (ticket writeback note 3).
